description: This file defines a Flutter widget for editing or creating notes, including form fields for title, content, and category, with save functionality integrated with provider-based state management.

classes.name: NoteEditScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget for creating or editing a note, with fields for title, content, and category, and logic to save the note using provider.

classes.name: _NoteEditScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the form fields, saving logic, and user interactions for NoteEditScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes text controllers and category ID based on the note passed to the widget.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Handles the save operation, validates input, updates or adds the note via provider, and navigates back.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the note editing/creation screen, including text fields, dropdown for category, and save button.
